verdict: A strong lead spike arrived; overdue milestones are now the bottleneck.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 18 leads from Meta at a cost of $96.34 per lead — a 90% drop in cost per lead compared to the prior 7-day period, driven by a sharp surge in the most recent week. That momentum is real, but day-by-day volume has flattened since the initial burst, so we're watching it closely rather than assuming it holds. Nine planned milestones are overdue — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and LSA re-enabling — and completing those is the clearest path to sustaining and scaling what Meta just unlocked. Those items are being worked through now, with heating campaigns and creative the immediate priority heading into the fall season.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
cost per lead this period, down 90% from the week prior
total actions taken on your Google Business profiles this period (calls, directions, website clicks)

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but a gap in confirmed intake ownership means inquiries may not be getting followed up on — this is a pipeline issue, not an ads issue.
watch_item.fix: Confirming an intake owner is the immediate action in motion; until that is locked, the lead volume you're generating is not being fully worked.
